open.message: 5 headline(s) switch typeface or to italic mid-line (the "one italic serif word" move).
open.fix: Set the whole headline in one face. Emphasis comes from the words.

open.message: 12 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "The spice shelf" above "Shop the Darbar"; "The brass thali" above "Seven katoris. One lazy susan."; "Origins" above "Six regions, six spice kingdoms"; "Malabar" above "The Pepper Coast"; "Rasoi Darbar" above "A hamper for every festival"
open.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

open.message: 53 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "Free shipping above ₹499", "❖", "Cash on delivery available", "❖").
open.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

open.message: Emoji in the page: ❖ ★ ❀
open.fix: Remove. Use words or real imagery.

open.message: 14 gradient fill(s): div.hero-sky → linear-gradient(rgb(27, 20, 80), rgb(107, 31, 120) 55%, rgb(242, 106, 74) 90%, rgb(255, 179, 71)) | section#thali.thali-sec → radial-gradient(at 50% 30%, rgb(44, 26, 115), rgb(30, 27, 94) 60%, rgb(18, 15, 62)) | section#occasions.section.occasions → radial-gradient(circle at 20% 0%, rgba(216, 27, 118, 0.35), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 50%), radial-gradient(circle at 9
open.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

open.message: 42 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: button.pill.on → rgb(216, 27, 118) 0px 3px 0px 0px | article.pcard → rgb(107, 58, 30) 6px 6px 0px 0px | button.btn.btn-add → rgb(142, 14, 75) 0px 3px 0px 0px
open.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

open.message: 6 text-shadow(s).
open.fix: Remove; fix legibility with a scrim or a different crop.

open.message: Buttons with shadow/glow.
open.fix: Flat fill, one colour.

open.message: 6 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): a 296px | a 296px | a 296px | a 296px
open.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.

open.message: 7 dashed/dotted border(s).
open.fix: Remove unless it is a real drop zone.

open.message: 1 row(s) of identical cards each topped with a small icon (8 cards).
open.fix: Replace with one composed section from the direction: a narrative split, a list set in large type, or real imagery per item.

open.message: Yellow-cream background (page background #fff6e5, section #fff6e5, section #ffefd0).
open.fix: Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.

open.message: Low-contrast text: "केसरी" 3.2:1 needs 4.5:1
open.fix: Darken or lighten the text colour.

open.message: 6 typefaces in use (Poppins, Mukta, Rozha One, Cormorant Garamond, Yeseva One, Tiro Devanagari Hindi).
open.fix: Two at most: one display, one text. Often one is enough.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

open.message: Only 0 picture(s) on the page (0 photographs, footage or raster images, 0 interface fragments). Drawings in SVG do not count.
open.fix: Find real pictures of the subject's world with scripts/assets.mjs (photographs, archival images, maps, engravings, footage), download them to assets/ and give them room: a hero picture, one per section that has a subject, a full-width band. At least four, usually six to twelve.

open.message: No video anywhere on the page.
open.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

open.message: 1 row(s) scroll sideways with content past their edge.
open.fix: Jurors and most visitors read a row cut at the edge as clipped, not as scrollable. Wrap it onto more lines, or end it inside the grid.

open.message: 62 text blocks under 13px.
open.fix: Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

open.message: The title is not readable 1.2s after the page loaded (it is hidden).
open.fix: Put the headline in the HTML, painted on the first frame; the load sequence only adds arrival and is settled by 1.2s (references/motion.md, "Load sequence in 1.2 seconds"). No preloader, no gate, no waiting for the load event.

open.message: 1 section(s) have content at both edges and 3822px of nothing between: "Recipes from 28 states"
open.fix: Bring the two parts together on the grid, or put the picture or figure of the section in the middle. An empty middle third reads as a hole, the same as an empty half.

open.message: The page has no visible h1.
open.fix: Give the first screen a clear title in an h1 that says what this is (a name with what it does, the product with what it is for, the event with its date and place).

open.message: 2 text block(s) sit within 16px of the screen edge: "Haryana" (14px from the left); "Bajra khichdi" (14px from the left)
open.fix: Keep text inside the page margin (16–32px or more). Only display type deliberately bled past the edge may touch it.

open.message: Large text lies under another element at some scroll position: "Kesari केसरी" (screen 12, 100% hidden); "Step into the Kesari bazaar" (screen 3, 100% hidden); "Spices fit for a darbar." (screen 3, 100% hidden); "Shop the Darbar" (screen 3, 100% hidden)
open.fix: Nothing may sit on top of a headline or statement. Move the picture, shorten the pinned run, or raise the text above it (z-index) and give it a ground.

open.message: Pinned large text slides across pictures while the page scrolls: "Step into the Kesari bazaar" (screen 2, 100% over a picture)
open.fix: Jurors read a pinned title crossing drawings or photographs as a collision. Keep the pictures in the column the title does not occupy, or unpin it.

open.message: The same large text stays on screen for 12 screens in a row: "Step into the Kesari bazaar"; "थाली खाली है"
open.fix: A pinned element earns two screens, and something must change at each. Shorten the run or give every screen its own content.

open.message: With reduced motion requested, 6 text block(s) on the first screen stay invisible: "Single-origin Indian spices · ground fre", "Step into the", "Kesari", "bazaar"
open.fix: Put every hidden starting state inside @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference); the reduced page is the finished page (references/motion.md §8).
